recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一個紅血球內單一、圓形、深紫紅色的小包涵體，即 Howell-Jolly 小體（核殘餘，提示脾功能低下或切脾後）；背景有大小不一的紅血球、標靶細胞、碎片及右上角的有核紅血球，符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Red cell with a single small, round, dense purple Howell-Jolly body (arrow)
Marked anisocytosis including microcytes and larger round cells
Poikilocytes including target cells, fragments, and irregular forms
Nucleated red blood cell with dense nucleus at upper right
Granulocyte at top of the field; scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with microcytes, target cells, and fragmented red cells. The arrow marks a red cell containing a single small, round, dense purple Howell-Jolly body. A nucleated red blood cell is present at the upper right, together with a granulocyte and scattered platelets. Howell-Jolly bodies indicate splenic hypofunction or prior splenectomy, which is common in thalassemia major. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major with Howell-Jolly bodies.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple small peripheral clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, not a single round central-to-eccentric dot.
A platelet on top of a red cell is larger with a pale hyalomere and granular center and lies in a different focal plane.
Plasmodium rings show a chromatin dot attached to a thin blue cytoplasmic ring rather than a solitary dense dot.
Stippling consists of many fine or coarse blue dots distributed throughout the red cell.
